So we built Dogify. For dogs.
When Ravi leaves for rehearsal, he feels guilty. And Pablo, home alone, feels lonely.
We read fifteen research papers, plus Reddit and Twitter. Up to one in five dogs struggle when left alone.
One. Ravi sends a voice note.
Pablo walks right up to him.
Behind the scenes: sticky notes, laptops, a lot of wiring, and one very patient dog.
Dogs do speak. Dogify helps you listen.
